pixip · ui inventory

Widget breakdown

Every page and widget in the pixip web client, with a screenshot from the live app and a rendered example beside it. The page is deliberately neutral: paper, ink and one quiet blue-grey accent. The app is the only thing with the dark violet palette.

How to read a card. Selectors and tokens are the theming surface. The screenshot shows the widget in its real screen context; the embedded example is the real markup and CSS in an isolated shadow root.

Captured from a local daemon on 2026-11-23, phone 390×844 at 2× and desktop 1280×900 at 1×. The same transcript and dashboard are used throughout.

Source of truth src/client/*.css and the modules listed in ARCHITECTURE.md.

Overall widget view

Every screen, every widget

A neutral inventory of the pixip web client. The page around the examples stays paper-colored and quiet; the app's own dark chrome, purple accent and mono type are the only saturated things on screen.

The screenshots were captured from a live daemon at 390 px (phone, 2×) and 1280 px (desktop, 1×). The examples beside them are the real markup rendered with the real client CSS inside an isolated shadow root, so you can inspect a widget without leaving this page.

Screen map

Palette

The token contract every widget reads from. Change these 12 colors and the app re-themes without touching a selector.

--bg #16141f Page, composer field, surface field
--bg-soft #1d1a29 Rows, cards, surface shell, code blocks
--bg-raised #241f33 Popovers, sheets, toast, active menu row
--line #322b45 Every border and divider
--fg #e7e3f2 Primary text
--fg-dim #9b93b4 Secondary text, buttons, hints
--fg-faint #6f6889 Timestamps, labels, subtitles
--accent #bb9af7 Assistant rail, primary buttons, links, focus
--user #7aa2f7 User block rail and label
--ok #9ece6a Idle dot, bash prompt
--warn #e0af68 Busy dot, tool name, banner, context warning
--err #f7768e Error dot, stop button, danger actions

Grouped by the screen that owns each widget. Click a name to jump to its card and embedded example.

Screen 01 Session list and dashboard
App header bar
One sticky header serves the dashboard and a session. The back button only exists on a session; settings only on the dashboard; stop only on a session; the overflow menu exists on both.
 #bar · #back · #titles/#title/#sub · .dot · #settings · #stop · #more-wrap/.bar-menu --bg, --line, --fg, --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --accent, --err, --ok, --warn
Status dot
A single 9 px dot encodes session state in the header and in every session row. Busy and starting pulse; the same class names drive both places.
 .dot · .dot.busy · .dot.idle · .dot.starting · .dot.stopped · .dot.error --ok, --warn, --accent, --fg-faint, --err
New session form
The first item in the list: a cwd field, a browse button that opens the directory sheet, and the primary new button. It never creates a session itself on browse; new pushes the synthetic #new route and sends create.
 #new-row · #new-row input · #new-row button · #new-row button.browse --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --accent, --pad
Bulk archive action
A secondary, self-starting button shown only when stopped sessions can be archived. Its count is the number of stopped rows that would hide, keeping one row in a group that has no active session.
 .bulk-archive --bg, --line, --fg-dim, --accent
CWD group header
Sessions are grouped by exact cwd. The header carries the expand/collapse chevron, shortened path, optional git branch chip, visible/total count, and a plus button that starts a new session in that cwd.
 .group · .group-head · .group-toggle · .group-chevron · .group-path · .group-branch · .group-count · .group-new --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --line, --accent
Session row
One logical session. The open half is the tap target (dot, name, state · relative time); the 38 px actions half opens the archive/delete sheet. The row never navigates on the actions button.
 .row · .row-open · .row-top · .row-name · .row-state · .row-actions · .row.wake --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --fg-faint, --accent, --err
Empty state
The dashboard's only zero-data row: a single quiet row with the text no sessions yet. It reuses the row shell so the list's rhythm does not change.
 .row.row-state --bg-soft, --line, --fg-dim
Header overflow popover
The … button opens a compact popover with transcript text size (A−, current percentage, A+) and a soft reload action. It is positioned relative to the bar-more wrapper and closes on Escape or outside focus.
 #more-wrap/.bar-more · #bar-menu · #scale · .scale-btn · .scale-value · #reload --bg-raised, --line, --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --accent
Screen 02 Transcript and session chrome
Transcript log
The only transcript scroll container. It is a flex column with a 10 px gap, a 104ch reading width and a transcript-only font scale. Live deltas append; snapshots fill in chunks without moving the reading position.
 #log · #log > * · .block --bg, --pad, --transcript-scale, --fg
User block
A user prompt with the blue role rail and the you label. Snapshot blocks also carry the fork affordance; recorded images render as thumbnails that open the image sheet. Text is pre-wrapped, not markdown.
 .block.user · .block.user .who · .fork-action · .msg-images · .msg-image --user, --bg-soft, --line, --fg-faint, --accent
Assistant block
The assistant rail and markdown body. Headings, lists, tables, fenced code, inline code, blockquotes and links all have transcript-specific styles; markdown is rendered once via the vendored renderer, never per delta.
 .block.assistant · .block.assistant .text · .md-table · pre/code · blockquote · a --accent, --fg, --fg-dim, --bg-soft, --line
Thinking disclosure
Pi thinking is collapsed by default; the summary is the only visible affordance and the body stays unparsed until opened. The transient thinking indicator is a separate block class.
 details.think · details.think summary · .block.thinking-indicator --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --accent
Tool card
A tool call and its output in one details element. The summary shows tool name, one-line argument summary and optional duration; output is ANSI-converted once on end and capped at 60dvh. Errors and empty calls get their own classes.
 details.tool · details.tool > summary · .tool-name · .tool-arg · .tool-time · .tool-out · .error · .empty --bg-soft, --line, --warn, --err, --fg-dim, --fg-faint
Bash card
A !/!! command rendered as a terminal card. The header has the green prompt, command and optional excluded badge; output is streamed in place; the meta line carries exit code, cancellation, truncation or full-output path.
 .block.bash · .bash-head · .bash-prompt · .bash-cmd · .badge · .bash-out · .bash-meta · .running · .error · .empty --bg-soft, --line, --ok, --warn, --err, --accent
Meta block
Non-message records: compaction summaries, branch summaries, custom notes, restart notices, the starting hint and the no-messages placeholder. They share the quiet rail and meta-head/meta-body typography.
 .block.meta · .block.starting · .block.restart · .meta-head · .meta-body · .pending-session --line, --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --accent
New-session shell
The instant new-session window: the dashboard's create is in flight, so the session shell paints starting session… with a disabled composer. On failure it paints a local error block and a back action instead of a dead id.
 #session[hidden=false] · .pending-session · .block.meta.error · .row.wake --accent, --fg-faint, --err, --bg-soft
Load earlier
A full-width button above the oldest painted entry. It requests the preceding 200-entry JSONL window; while loading it is disabled, and the scroll position is held after the prepend.
 .earlier · .earlier:disabled --bg-soft, --line, --fg-dim, --accent
Jump to newest
A floating pill that appears only while scrolled up. It sits above the surface using --surface-height, aligned with the 104ch log column, and never covers the composer.
 #jump · #jump[hidden] --bg-raised, --line, --fg-dim, --accent
Status footer
Two TUI-parity lines below the composer: cwd (branch) • session name, then token/cost/context stats and the model • thinking level. Context color crosses warning at 70 % and error at 90 %.
 #footer · .fline.pwd · .fline.stats · .left · .right · [data-level=warning|error] --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --warn, --err
Screen 03 Composer, command menu and queue
Composer row
The primary input: a + attachment button, a 16 px auto-growing textarea and the send button. Enter sends on fine pointers, Shift+Enter always newlines; on coarse pointers Enter adds a newline.
 #composer · #compose-row · #attach · #input · #send --bg-soft, --line, --accent, --fg-dim
Attachment card
One pending attachment at a time: an image thumbnail or a file icon, name, size/dimensions/upload state, and a remove button. Error and busy states reuse the card with an error border and a status line.
 .attachment-card · .attachment-card.error · .attachment-icon · .attachment-meta · .attachment-name · .attachment-sub · .attachment-remove --bg-soft, --line, --bg-raised, --fg-faint, --err, --accent
Attachment menu
The + button opens two choices: photo/camera (image picker) or choose file (generic upload). The menu is part of the dock, so opening it shrinks the transcript instead of covering it.
 #attach-menu · #attach-menu button · #attach[aria-expanded=true] --bg-raised, --line, --fg, --accent
Command menu
Typing / opens the filtered command catalog above the composer. Rows show name, argument hint, summary and a TUI-only tag; arrows move, Enter/Tab inserts, Escape closes, and a tap keeps focus.
 #menu · .menu-row · .menu-row.active · .menu-row.tui · .menu-name · .menu-args · .menu-summary · .menu-hint --bg, --bg-raised, --line, --accent, --fg-dim, --fg-faint
Pending queue chips
Pi's steering/follow-up queue above the composer: a count, a clear X, and one pill per pending text. A tap expands a long chip in place; clearing restores the texts into the composer unsent.
 #queue · .queue-head · .queue-label · .queue-clear · .queue-chips · .queue-chip · .queue-chip.expanded --bg-soft, --line, --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --err
Screen 04 Blocking extension requests
Surface shell
The frame shared by every blocking request: title/status row, collapse and cancel controls, an optional Replace banner, and a body that scrolls internally. It is docked between #log and the composer, never fixed or modal.
 #surface · .surface-head · .surface-titles · .surface-title · .surface-status · .surface-collapse · .surface-close · .surface-body --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --fg-faint, --accent, --surface-history-sliver
Replace banner
When a second blocking request arrives it is queued, not stacked. The banner says how many are waiting and the Replace button cancels the active request so the queued one can mount.
 .surface-banner · .surface-banner-text · .surface-replace --warn, --bg-soft, --line, --bg-raised
Select request
Extension ctx.ui.select: one full-width action per option plus cancel. Long labels wrap instead of clipping, and every button is at least a comfortable tap target.
 .surface-actions · .surface-actions button · .surface-actions button.primary --bg-raised, --line, --accent, --fg
Confirm request
Extension ctx.ui.confirm: a primary yes, a neutral no and cancel. Yes/no labels come from the extension; the primary class is the only accent border in the stack.
 .surface-actions button.primary · .surface-actions button --accent, --bg-raised, --line, --fg
Input and editor fields
Extension ctx.ui.input and ctx.ui.editor: a hint, a 16 px field (textarea for editor), then send/cancel. Enter submits; Escape cancels; the editor accepts Shift+Enter newlines.
 .surface-hint · .surface-field · input.surface-field · textarea.surface-field · .surface-actions --bg, --line, --fg, --fg-dim, --accent
Re-ask card
A timed-out request is stored on disk and shown as a read-only re-ask card on resume. Re-ask prompts the agent to issue the same call again; dismiss retires it without sending anything.
 .surface-hint · .surface-actions .primary --bg-soft, --line, --fg-dim, --accent
More-time card
When a long-lived request reaches its timeout, the hub asks whether to keep it open. More time revives the original request; shelve cancels it and saves the panel draft separately.
 .surface-hint · .surface-actions .primary --bg-soft, --line, --fg-dim, --accent
Screen 05 A2UI panels and extension widgets
Panel fallback
With no renderer for a panel mode, or when a renderer throws, the surface shows a visible fallback card instead of a blank body. The request can still be cancelled.
 .panel-fallback · .panel-fallback-title · .panel-fallback-detail · .panel-fallback button.primary --warn, --bg-soft, --line, --bg-raised, --accent
A2UI panel
A2UI panels are opaque messages rendered by the vendored Lit catalog inside the same surface. The wrapper maps the app palette to A2UI color tokens; unknown component types fall back rather than injecting markup.
 .a2ui-root · .a2ui-root a2ui-surface · .a2ui-loading --bg-soft, --bg-raised, --fg, --accent, --line (mapped to --a2ui-* variables)
Add-on widgets and statuses
Pi's fire-and-forget setStatus/setWidget output. Statuses join one footer line; widgets are placed above or below the composer inside the footer, in first-seen key order, and clear when an empty value arrives.
 #footer .addon-widgets.above · #footer .addon-widgets.below · #footer .addon-statuses · .addon-widget --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --line
Screen 06 App-owned modal sheets
Sheet shell
The bottom modal frame: a title row with the x, optional hint/text, then a vertical action stack. Sheets are app-owned; Pi dialogs use the inline surface instead. Escape or x dismisses.
 #sheet · .sheet-header · .sheet-title · .sheet-close · .sheet-hint · .sheet-text · .sheet-actions --bg-raised, --line, --fg, --fg-dim, --accent, --safe-b
Sheet action stack
Every sheet's action column: neutral rows, an accent primary, a danger row, and the current/checked state. Download rows are anchors but use the same visual weight.
 .sheet-actions · .sheet-actions button · button.primary · button.danger · a.sheet-download · .current --bg-soft, --line, --accent, --err, --fg
Settings sheet
The dashboard settings: a checkbox row for keeping hot/warm/newest sessions visible while collapsed, a hint explaining the rule, and entries into archived/trash.
 .settings-row · .settings-row input · .settings-text · .settings-hint --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --fg-faint, --accent
Archived and trash list
Restorable sessions in the settings sheet. Each row shows name and cwd · age, with restore plus delete/purge. Empty lists say nothing archived or trash is empty.
 .stored-list · .stored-row · .stored-info · .stored-name · .stored-meta · .stored-actions --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --fg-faint, --accent, --err
Session actions sheet
The row's ⋯ action: archive or delete one session. Both lead to a confirm sheet; archive hides and keeps files, delete moves them to trash with a short undo window.
 .row-actions · #sheet .sheet-actions --bg-raised, --line, --err, --fg
Confirm sheet
A message-first sheet for archive/delete/bulk actions. The confirm button carries the danger border; cancel is the neutral escape. It never uses window.confirm except for permanent purge.
 .sheet-text · .sheet-actions button.danger · .sheet-actions button --err, --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --fg-dim
Directory picker
Browse for a new session cwd. Breadcrumbs, a live filter, parent/repo rows, a new-folder form, use this directory and close. Listing is a REST discovery call fenced to $HOME; it never creates a session.
 .dir-sheet · .dir-crumbs/.dir-crumb · .dir-filter · .dir-list/.dir-row · .dir-name · .dir-badge · .dir-parent · .dir-mkdir · .dir-use --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --fg-dim, --fg-faint, --accent
Session tree sheet
A read-only view of Pi's session tree: indentation follows nesting, the current branch is marked, the leaf row is raised, and user entries get fork and copy-prompt actions.
 .tree · .tree-row · .tree-row.current · .tree-row.leaf · .tree-head · .tree-role · .tree-label · .tree-current · .tree-text · .tree-actions --bg-soft, --bg-raised, --line, --accent, --user, --warn
Export sheet
Download links for the HTML export and the session's own JSONL. The JSONL row only appears when Pi has a file yet; both are attachment responses from the export REST route.
 .sheet-text · a.sheet-download · .sheet-actions --bg-soft, --line, --fg, --accent
Image sheet
A recorded or pending image opened at a larger size. The image is contained within 70dvh and the sheet is the only way to inspect it without leaving the transcript.
 .sheet-image · #sheet .sheet-actions --bg-raised, --line, --fg-dim
Notice text sheet
Long or multi-line extension notices become a sheet with a pre-wrapped body; short notices use the toast. This keeps terminal-only command explanations readable on a phone.
 .sheet-text · #sheet pre.sheet-text --bg-raised, --fg-dim, --line
Toast
Short feedback above the composer: 3.2 s for a toast, longer when it carries an action such as undo. Toasts never enter the transcript and are dismissed by their timer.
 #toast · .toast-action --bg-raised, --line, --fg-dim, --accent

<section class="block assistant">
  <div class="who">pi</div>
  <div class="text">
    <h2>Widget inventory</h2>
    <p>Every block is typed by role. Inline <code>code</code> shares the code surface.</p>
    <ul><li>dashboard rows</li><li>transcript blocks</li><li>surface cards</li></ul>

Tokens, selectors and state classes

Everything the widget cards expose, collected in one place for a theming pass. The app is one asset set: no bundler, no per-breakpoint markup, no framework.

Token contract

Defined once in src/client/base.css. Status colors are semantic, not decorative.

TokenDefaultUsed byMeaning
--bg#16141fPage, composer field, surface fieldBase canvas
--bg-soft#1d1a29Rows, cards, surface shell, code blocksRaised but quiet
--bg-raised#241f33Popovers, sheets, toast, active menu rowTopmost surface
--line#322b45Every border and dividerOne line token everywhere
--fg#e7e3f2Primary textBody and labels
--fg-dim#9b93b4Secondary text, buttons, hintsMost chrome
--fg-faint#6f6889Timestamps, labels, subtitlesLowest legibility tier
--accent#bb9af7Assistant rail, primary buttons, links, focusPi / action
--user#7aa2f7User block rail and labelUser role
--ok#9ece6aIdle dot, bash promptHealthy
--warn#e0af68Busy dot, tool name, banner, context warningAttention
--err#f7768eError dot, stop button, danger actionsFailure
--monomono stackAll app textCode-native interface
--pad12pxHeader, list, log, composer, surfaceSpacing unit
--safe-benv(safe-area-inset-bottom)Dock and sheet bottom paddingPhone safe area
--transcript-scale1#log font size onlyA−/A+ transcript size

Selector map

The seven stylesheets are loaded in this order from index.html. Keep the order: later files rely on earlier shell rules.

FileOwnsPrimary selectors
base.cssReset, tokens, header, shell, jump pill:root · #bar · #titles · .ghost · .dot · #log · #jump
transcript.cssBlocks, markdown, thinking, tools, bash.block.user/.assistant/.meta · details.think · details.tool · .block.bash · .earlier
list.cssDashboard form, rows, groups#list · #new-row · .row · .group-head · .group-branch · .group-new
status.cssDock, footer, command menu, queue#dock · #footer · #menu · .menu-row · #queue · .queue-chip
composer.cssComposer row and attachment card#composer · #compose-row · #attach · #input · #send · .attachment-card
sheets.cssModal sheets, directory picker, tree, toast#sheet · .sheet-actions · .dir-row · .tree-row · #toast
surface.cssInline surface and A2UI bridge#surface · .surface-head · .surface-banner · .panel-fallback · .a2ui-root

State classes

State is expressed as a class next to the widget, never as a separate component. A theme must keep these legible.

Session state

.dot.idle · .dot.busy · .dot.starting · .dot.stopped · .dot.error

Header and row share the same vocabulary. Busy/starting animate with pulse; reduced motion disables it.

Transcript blocks

.block.user · .block.assistant · .block.meta · .block.starting · .block.restart · .block.thinking-indicator · .block.bash

Role rail color is the fastest cue. Bash adds .running · .error · .empty · .excluded.

Disclosures

details.think · details.tool · details.tool.error · details.tool.empty · [open]

Summary is the only visible row when closed; output is unparsed until opened.

Surface

#surface.collapsed · .surface-banner · .panel-fallback · .surface-actions button.primary

Collapse hides body and banner. Fallback uses a dashed warning border.

Sheets

.sheet-actions button.primary · .danger · .current · .settings-row · .stored-row · .tree-row.current/.leaf

Accent means primary; error means destructive; current/leaf are selection states.

Menu and queue

.menu-row.active · .menu-row.tui · .queue-chip.expanded · .queue-clear

TUI-only rows are dimmed, not hidden. Queue chips are read-only until expanded.

Responsive contract

One markup, CSS media/container queries only. A desktop view must add information, not stretch a single column.

Widths

  • #log, #composer, #footer, #surface: 104ch
  • #list: 760px
  • directory sheet content: 760px
  • A2UI font scale changes at 768px
  • .wide is hidden at 560px (header subtitle)

Units and input

  • 100dvh shell; safe-area bottom inset
  • textarea and sheet fields are 16px so iOS does not zoom
  • sticky dock; #log is the only transcript scroll container
  • transcript scale changes --transcript-scale on #log only
  • no user-agent branching, no duplicated markup per breakpoint

Retheme checklist

A safe order for a palette pass.

  1. Set the twelve colors in :root first. Do not edit individual widget declarations until the palette settles.
  2. Check .dot states and the footer context levels: they are the only semantic color users read without reading text.
  3. Check the three app surfaces in order: page (--bg), quiet card (--bg-soft), popover/sheet (--bg-raised).
  4. Check user rail, assistant rail, tool name, bash prompt and error/danger. These must remain distinguishable in grayscale.
  5. Check 390 and 1280 with the real client, then run tools/shot.mjs for layout box metrics.
  6. Update ARCHITECTURE.md if a change moves a latency number or the responsive contract.
